dict.string: Turn on and return to Med Tracker to open a different account or leave local mode. Data stored on this iPhone is kept.
Privacy policy: github.com/korjavin/medicationtrackerbot/blob/master/docs/privacy-policy.md. In the app: Settings → Account & privacy.
Test build only. Turn on and return to Med Tracker to run the on-device storage checks; your account and its data are not touched.
No account: your data is stored only on this iPhone and in its backup. Turn off to go back to your account. Data on either side is kept.

Local mode only: asks for Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode each time you return to Med Tracker. It hides the app; it does not encrypt your data, and reminders on the Lock Screen still show (Reminder text in the app sets what they say). Turning it off takes effect after your next unlock.
